description: Alertes trafic du réseau des Transports en Commun Lyonnais (v2) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SYTRAL Mobilités. Traffic alerts identify service changes to the Transports en Commun Lyonnais (TCL) network compared to the usual service. Changes are those impacted by unexpected disturbances or planned works. Coverage: SYTRAL Mobilités. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic alerts of the Transport network in Commun Lyonnais (v2)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SYTRAL Mobilités. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2025-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
